entries.sense_note: person who takes payment in a shop

def.short: a person in a shop or supermarket whose job is to take your money
def.long: A person whose job is to take money from customers in a shop, supermarket or bank. You pay the cashier when you finish your shopping.

grammar.pattern: pay the cashier / ask the cashier

examples.en: The cashier gave me my receipt and smiled.
examples.tr: Kasiyer fişimi verdi ve gülümsedi.

examples.en: Ask the cashier if you can pay by card.
examples.tr: Kartla ödeyip ödeyemeyeceğini kasiyere sor.

examples.en: Zeynep works as a cashier in a big supermarket on weekends.
examples.tr: Zeynep hafta sonları büyük bir süpermarkette kasiyer olarak çalışıyor.

etymology.text: From French 'caissier', from 'caisse' (money box); 'cash' has the same root. Turkish 'kasa' (from Italian 'cassa') also goes back to Latin 'capsa' (box).

tr.note: Türkçedeki 'kasiyer' ile aynı anlamdadır. Ödeme yapılan yerin kendisine ise 'checkout' denir; İngiltere'de 'till' de duyarsın.

quiz.cloze: The ______ scanned my milk and eggs and said, “That's 85 lira, please.”

entries.sense_note: pay point in a shop or online

def.short: the place in a shop where you pay, or the last step when you buy online
def.long: The place in a supermarket or shop where you pay for the things you want to buy. In online shopping, it is the last step, where you enter your address and pay.

grammar.pattern: at the checkout / go to (the) checkout

examples.en: Please take your basket to the checkout.
examples.tr: Lütfen sepetini kasaya götür.

examples.en: The self-service checkouts were faster, so I used one.
examples.tr: Self servis kasalar daha hızlıydı, ben de birini kullandım.

examples.en: I added three books to my basket online, but I never went to checkout.
examples.tr: İnternette sepetime üç kitap ekledim ama ödeme adımına hiç geçmedim.

tr.note: Bitişik yazılan bir isimdir. Ayrı yazılan 'check out' ise fiildir: otelden çıkış yapmak ya da bir şeye göz atmak. 'checkout' = kasa ya da internette ödeme adımı.

quiz.cloze: Our trolley is full. Let's go to the ______ and pay.

entries.sense_note: shopping basket, in a shop or online

def.short: a light container with handles for the things you want to buy in a shop
def.long: A light container with handles that you carry around a shop for the things you want to buy. On shopping websites, your basket is the list of things you plan to buy.

grammar.pattern: put sth in your basket / add to basket

examples.en: I only need milk, so I'll take a basket.
examples.tr: Sadece süt lazım, o yüzden bir sepet alacağım.

examples.en: Kenji put two apples and some bread in his basket.
examples.tr: Kenji sepetine iki elma ve biraz ekmek koydu.

examples.en: Your basket is empty. Add something before you go to checkout.
examples.tr: Sepetin boş. Ödemeye geçmeden önce bir şey ekle.

tr.note: Tekerlekli büyük alışveriş arabasına İngiltere'de 'trolley', Amerika'da 'cart' denir. Amerikan sitelerinde internet sepeti de genelde 'cart' olur.

quiz.cloze: I only need three things, so I don't need a trolley. A ______ is enough.

entries.sense_note: person who helps customers in a shop

def.micro: person who helps in a shop
def.short: a person whose job is to help customers and sell things in a shop
def.long: A person who works in a shop. They help customers find things, answer questions and sell things. In American English, people usually say 'salesperson'.

examples.en: I asked the shop assistant for a bigger size.
examples.tr: Satış görevlisinden bir beden büyüğünü istedim.

examples.en: The shop assistant showed us where the shoes were.
examples.tr: Satış görevlisi bize ayakkabıların nerede olduğunu gösterdi.

examples.en: Sofia works as a shop assistant in a bookshop on Saturdays.
examples.tr: Sofia cumartesileri bir kitapçıda satış görevlisi olarak çalışıyor.

tr.note: Amerikan İngilizcesinde daha çok 'salesperson' denir. Kasada parayı alan kişi ise 'cashier' olur.

quiz.cloze: In the shop, I couldn't find jeans in my size, so I asked a ______ for help.

entries.sense_note: small room for trying on clothes

def.short: a small room in a clothes shop where you put on clothes before you buy them
def.long: A small private room in a clothes shop where you can put on clothes to see if they fit and look good before you buy them. In American English, people also say 'dressing room'.

examples.en: Where is the fitting room?
examples.tr: Deneme kabini nerede?

examples.en: The fitting rooms were busy, so we waited ten minutes.
examples.tr: Deneme kabinleri doluydu, o yüzden on dakika bekledik.

examples.en: You can only take five things into the fitting room.
examples.tr: Deneme kabinine en fazla beş parça alabilirsin.

tr.note: İngiltere'de 'changing room', Amerika'da 'dressing room' da denir. Kabinde kıyafet denemek için 'try on' kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: I want to see if this dress fits me. Where is the ______?

entries.sense_note: times when a place is open

def.micro: times when a shop is open
def.short: the times of the day when a shop, bank or museum is open
def.long: The times of the day or week when a shop, bank, museum or other place is open for people. They are often written on the door or on the website.

grammar.pattern: the opening hours of / sb's opening hours

examples.en: What are your opening hours?
examples.tr: Çalışma saatleriniz nedir?

examples.en: The opening hours are on the door: 9 a.m. to 8 p.m.
examples.tr: Çalışma saatleri kapıda yazıyor: sabah 9'dan akşam 8'e kadar.

examples.en: Omar checked the opening hours online before he went to the bank.
examples.tr: Omar bankaya gitmeden önce çalışma saatlerine internetten baktı.

tr.note: Hep çoğul kullanılır: 'opening hours'. Kapanış saati için 'closing time' denir.

quiz.cloze: You can visit the museum from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Those are its ______.

entries.sense_note: deciding to buy something in a shop

def.short: what you say in a shop when you decide to buy something
def.long: You say this in a shop or market when you decide to buy the thing you are looking at. It is a short, natural way to say 'I want to buy this.'

grammar.pattern: I'll take it / I'll take them

examples.en: I love this bag. I'll take it.
examples.tr: Bu çantaya bayıldım. Alıyorum.

examples.en: “It's 300 lira.” “OK, I'll take it.”
examples.tr: “300 lira.” “Tamam, alıyorum.”

examples.en: The jacket fits well and the price is good, so I'll take it.
examples.tr: Ceket iyi oturuyor, fiyatı da güzel, o yüzden alıyorum.

tr.note: Birden fazla şey için 'I'll take them' denir. 'I will buy it' de doğrudur ama mağazada 'I'll take it' çok daha doğal.

def.short: the name of a company that makes a type of product
def.long: The name that a company gives to the things it makes, so people know who made them. People often choose a brand they trust.

grammar.pattern: a brand of sth / What brand is it?

examples.en: What brand is your phone?
examples.tr: Telefonun hangi marka?

examples.en: This shampoo is a cheap brand, but it works well.
examples.tr: Bu şampuan ucuz bir marka ama işe yarıyor.

examples.en: Leo only buys one brand of coffee because he loves the taste.
examples.tr: Leo tadına bayıldığı için yalnızca tek bir marka kahve alıyor.

etymology.text: Old English 'brand' meant fire. Later it meant a mark burned onto animals or goods to show the owner, and then a company's name.

tr.note: Türkçedeki 'marka' İngilizcede 'brand' olur. İngilizce 'mark' ise iz, leke ya da sınav notu demektir.

quiz.cloze: I like this ______ of jeans. Their jeans always fit me well.

entries.sense_note: available to buy, e.g. a house or car

def.short: available for people to buy, often used for houses, cars and used things
def.long: Available to buy because the owner wants to sell it. You often see these words on signs for houses, cars and used things.

grammar.pattern: be for sale / put sth up for sale

examples.en: Our neighbors' house is for sale.
examples.tr: Komşularımızın evi satılık.

examples.en: Is this bike for sale? How much is it?
examples.tr: Bu bisiklet satılık mı? Kaç para?

examples.en: Emre put his old car up for sale last week.
examples.tr: Emre geçen hafta eski arabasını satışa çıkardı.

tr.note: 'for sale' = satılık. 'on sale' ise çoğunlukla 'indirimde' demektir. Ev ya da araba tabelasında 'For Sale' yazar.

quiz.cloze: The Yılmaz family is moving to another city, so their flat is ______.

entries.sense_note: none left to sell right now

def.micro: none left in the shop now
def.short: not available because the shop has no more of it at the moment
def.long: Not available in a shop or on a website because there are none left at the moment. The opposite is 'in stock'.

examples.en: Sorry, this size is out of stock.
examples.tr: Üzgünüm, bu beden stokta yok.

examples.en: The black one is out of stock online, but the shop has some.
examples.tr: Siyah olan internette stokta yok ama mağazada var.

examples.en: Hana wanted the new game, but it was out of stock everywhere.
examples.tr: Hana yeni oyunu istiyordu ama her yerde stokta yoktu.

tr.note: Karşıtı 'in stock' (stokta var). 'sell out' bir fiildir ('The tickets sold out'); 'out of stock' ise 'be' ile kullanılır: 'It is out of stock.'

quiz.cloze: I wanted to order the blue sofa, but the website said it was ______.
